'''Ember Armor''' is an {{Epic}} [[Armor]] set that allows the player to turn nearby lava into {{Item|Obsidian}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Magma Cube Boss ===
The {{MobSprite|Magma Cube Boss}} had a small chance of dropping a random piece of this armor upon death. 

=== Crafting ===
The armor can be crafted using {{Item|Ember Fragment}}s, which had a chance to drop from the {{MobSprite|Magma Cube Boss}}. While {{Item|Ember Fragment}}s are no longer obtainable except via trading with players, the armor pieces can still be crafted.

=== Lava Immunity ===
Wearing a full set of '''Ember Armor''' grants the player immunity to damage from fire and lava. It also turns nearby lava into {{Item|Obsidian}} (except in {{zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}).

=== Kuudra Follower Chestplate ===
To obtain the {{Item|Kuudra Follower Chestplate}}, six players are needed. These players must be wearing {{Item|Ember Armor}} or {{Item|Rekindled Ember Armor}} with a {{Lv|81}} or higher {{Item|Kuudra Pet}} summoned.
* 2 players, one from each faction, must stand in the {{Zone|Stronghold}}.
* 2 players in the [[Barbarian Faction]] must stand in the {{Zone|Dragontail Townsquare}}.
* 2 players in the [[Mage Faction]] must stand in the {{Zone|Scarleton Plaza}}.
The two players standing in the {{zone|Stronghold}}, as well as the other players on the server, can then speak to {{NPCSprite|Arch}} to claim the chestplate.

== Tips ==
* As this set is now unobtainable, two or more pieces of {{Item|Magma Lord Armor}} can also be used instead to grant lava immunity in the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} and {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}.
